title: "Destiny Card Activated"
next_chapter_hook: The blurred Jade Pendant in Ye Qing's sleeve stirred a tempest in Chen Ji's heart—why would his sister's aura appear on the Holy Sect's Saint?

text.content:
A crack split open the ceiling of the trial space, and Chen Ji felt his soul being slowly extracted by some unknown force. It wasn't pain, but a more terrifying void—as if existence itself was being erased bit by bit.

"Is this the天道's dress rehearsal for death?" he murmured, yet instead of closing his eyes in retreat, he stared fixedly at the constantly forming images within that crack. It was a superposition of countless death moments: some consumed by flames, some pierced through the heart by blades, some slowly fading into nothingness in despair...

The Heavenly Fate Value plummeted. Ten points, twenty points, thirty points—Chen Ji felt the bond between himself and destiny being forcibly severed.

Just as his consciousness was about to completely dissolve, the Jade Pendant at Chen Ji's chest suddenly burned scalding hot. That destiny card, accidentally obtained from the ruins, was now devouring his remaining Heavenly Fate at an alarming rate.

"Seeking death!" Chen Ji roared, but didn't try to stop it. He suddenly realized—the Tianji Record Fragment was分担 his pressure—it voluntarily absorbed part of the death rehearsal's backlash in exchange for a moment of clarity for its master.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul剧烈波动 in the Mental Sea: "Master, absolutely not! This card's backlash... you are burning your lifespan!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, coldly smiling: "Burning my lifespan? I haven't lived enough yet! Since Heaven wants me dead, then I shall defy destiny and change my fate—show me!"

text.content:
The destiny card suddenly blazed with dazzling golden light, and a mysterious rune exploded before Chen Ji's eyes. Three breaths later, a completely different scene appeared in his vision—

It was a dark valley, amid pervasive demonic aura, Ye Qing was fleeing desperately. Behind her, three figures emitting terrifying auras gave chase without end. The three elders of the Holy Sect, each at Foundation Building late stage.

"Ye Qing..." Chen Ji's pupils constricted. In the vision, she was already wounded, her black纱裙 soaked through with blood, her steps stumbling.

The prophetic vision continued flowing. Chen Ji saw Ye Qing cornered deep in the valley, driven to a cliff's precipice. The Holy Sect Elder's mocking voice transmitted across space and time: "Your Highness Saint, did you think allying with that废物 could save you? Heaven has already decided—you are merely a lamb awaiting slaughter."

Ye Qing wiped the blood from her lips, coldly laughing: "A lamb awaiting slaughter? Hmph, let's see who the real lamb is."

She abruptly crushed the Jade Pendant in her hand, and a诡异波动 spread in all directions.

Chen Ji saw that the instant the Jade Pendant shattered, a blurry image emerged. It was the outline of a young girl, her features unclear, but those eyes—those eyes made Chen Ji's heart tighten violently.

It was his beloved sister. Chen Nian.

"Why..." Chen Ji stared死死的 at that blurry image, his hands unconsciously clenching tight. He saw that after Ye Qing crushed the Jade Pendant, she suddenly erupted, using some life透支秘法 to injure the leading elder, but she herself completely lost combat capability.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled as it spoke: "Master, that is... that is the aura of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key! This old servant would never mistake it! There must be some connection between Miss Chen Nian and this Saint!"

text.content:
The prophetic vision cut off precisely when Ye Qing fell from the cliff, but Chen Ji had already seen the key information: the enemy's ambush location was deep within the幽冥谷, the timing was three hours later, and the secret Ye Qing carried—perhaps related to Chen Nian.

"Three hours..." Chen Ji abruptly snapped back to reality, checking his condition. His Heavenly Fate Value had plummeted from 120 to 95, a consumption of 25 points. More terrifyingly, his lifespan... clearly reduced by at least ten years.

The death rehearsal of the trial space finally dissipated. Chen Ji stumbled but steadied himself. His entire body was soaked with cold sweat, his lips pale, yet his eyes blazed with remarkable intensity.

"Interesting." He licked his dry, cracked lips, a dangerous curve forming at the corners of his mouth, "Heaven wants to frighten me to death with death rehearsals? Hmph, it has delivered quite the timely rain."

Ye Qing was in danger, and possibly related to his sister. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, killing intent churning in his chest.

In the Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed helplessly: "Master, you consumed ten years of lifespan... this will affect your cultivation foundation. But this old servant understands—some things are more important than life."

Chen Ji didn't answer, his gaze already falling on the exit of the trial space. Three hours, neither long nor short. Enough time to do many things, but possibly too late for everything.

He needed to make a choice between "rapid rescue" and "secure planning."

choice.prompt: "Time is short, Ye Qing is in dire straits. Do you choose to immediately set out for the幽冥谷 to rescue, or calmly devise a foolproof plan first?"

choices.description: "Immediately set out, rush to the幽冥谷 at maximum speed. With your Foundation Building early stage strength, directly facing three Foundation Building late stages would be suicide. But if you can rescue Ye Qing before they encircle, there might be a slim chance."
choices.visible_reward: "Ye Qing's trust in you greatly increases, possibly obtaining key clues about Chen Nian"

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't hesitate in the slightest. His身形 flashed and vanished on the spot. Damn planning and schemes, damn foolproof approaches—Ye Qing carried clues about his sister, he couldn't wait.
"Ten years of lifespan exchanged for leads on my sister—this deal, I accept!"

choices.description: "First calmly analyze—the prophecy has already shown the enemy's ambush location and timing. You can set up teleportation arrays and困阵 before they encircle. Then you can attack when advantageous, retreat when needed, even counter-kill all three."
choices.visible_cost: "Requires extra preparation time, possibly missing the optimal rescue window"
choices.visible_reward: "Perfect ambush counter-kill, greatly improves strategic evaluation, possibly gaining Holy Sect intelligence"
choices.risk_hint: "Can Ye Qing hold on for three hours?"

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the restlessness in his heart.
"Alright, calm, I need to be calm." Every detail from the prophetic vision replayed in his mind: the valley's terrain, the enemies' positions, Ye Qing's injuries... He began constructing a perfect trap in his Mental Sea.
"Since you want to ambush me, I'll let you taste what being ambushed feels like."

However, the instant Chen Ji made his decision, an intense pain suddenly shot through his Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul惊恐地尖叫: "Master, bad news! The Tianji Record Fragment is wildly warning—a new variable has intervened!"

The prophetic vision abruptly distorted, and a blurry figure appeared at the spot where Ye Qing had fallen from the cliff. The person wore Tianqing Sect's standard robes, with a诡异面具 on their face. They bent down to pick up something Ye Qing had dropped, emitting a sinister low laugh.

dialogue.content:
The masked figure's voice was ancient and cold: "Interesting... the secret on the Demonic Path Saint is indeed related to that废物. Heaven helps me—this time, I'll let them tear each other apart."

Chen Ji's pupils violently contracted. That voice, that tone—he knew it too well—it was Ling Yuan! That old Sect Master who appeared benevolent on the surface but harbored dark ambitions!

text.content:
"Old thing..." Chen Ji growled low, his fists cracking.
So that was it—the Holy Sect elders' ambush wasn't coincidence. Ling Yuan had long been colluding with the Holy Sect. Not only did he want to use Ye Qing to deal with Chen Ji, he wanted to eliminate all opposing forces in one fell swoop.

Mo Xiansheng's voice was grave: "Master, the situation is more complex than anticipated. If Ling Yuan personally intervenes, even with thorough planning, you may not escape unharmed."

Chen Ji closed his eyes, rapidly calculating in his Mental Sea. Time was slipping away; every breath meant Ye Qing one step closer to death. But Ling Yuan's intervention made the situation unprecedentedly dangerous.

"I have two choices." he murmured to himself, "First, ignore Ling Yuan and save the person first. Second..."

A cold smile suddenly curved his lips—a nearly manic arc.
"Second, I'll show this old fool Ling Yuan what true flawless strategizing looks like."

choice.prompt: "Ling Yuan's intervention makes the situation even more dangerous. How do you decide to handle this unexpected variable?"

choices.description: "Since Ling Yuan wants to watch the show, give him a good show. Deliberately reveal yourself before him, drawing his attention away from Ye Qing. Simultaneously, secretly inform Su Qingyao to come for support."
choices.visible_cost: "Exposed to Ling Yuan's gaze, danger coefficient greatly increases"
choices.visible_reward: "Cause Ling Yuan to misjudge your strength, laying the groundwork for a later counterattack"
choices.risk_hint: "Playing chess against the old fox, outcome uncertain"

text.content:
Chen Ji coldly laughed, taking a communication Jade Talisman from his chest.
"Su Qingyao, haven't you been investigating me? Now, I give you an opportunity." He carved Ye Qing's location and Ling Yuan's conspiracy onto the talisman, then activated it.
"Come, let me see the Tianqing Sect Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's strength."

choices.memory_label: 告知苏青瑶关于夜清与凌渊的情报

choices.description: "What Ling Yuan wants is none of your concern. Your only goal—Ye Qing. You choose to directly ignore Ling Yuan's presence, rushing into the battlefield at maximum speed, taking Ye Qing away before anyone can react."
choices.visible_reward: "Maximum preservation of secrets Ye Qing carries"
choices.risk_hint: "Rushing alone into danger, nine deaths near certainty"

text.content:
Chen Ji hesitated no longer, urging all his spiritual energy into a streak of shadow rushing toward the幽冥谷 direction. The wind howled in his ears; one thought dominated his heart:
"Ye Qing, wait for me! No matter what schemes that old dog Ling Yuan harbors, the clues about Nian Nian you carry—I, Chen Ji, must obtain them!"

flags_set: 选择无视凌渊直接救人

text.content:
At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly glowed faintly. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul exclaimed: "Master! The Tianji Record sensed the aura of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—it's on Saint Ye Qing! That Jade Pendant she crushed was sealed with Miss Chen Nian's aura!"

Chen Ji's footsteps violently halted. His sister's aura, sealed in a Jade Pendant, kept by Ye Qing. What did this mean? What connection existed between them?

In the Mental Sea, countless thoughts flashed like lightning. Chen Nian was only ten when the Holy Sect took her; eight years had passed now. What had she experienced? Why would her aura appear in Ye Qing's possession? That Jade Pendant... had Chen Nian entrusted it to Ye Qing to pass to him?

"Little sister..." Chen Ji murmured softly, his eye sockets slightly reddening. That little girl who always timidly followed behind him in his memories—where was she now?

However, Chen Ji quickly收敛 his emotions. He took a deep breath, his gaze regaining its cold, sharp edge.
"What use is crying? What use is weakness?" He self-deprecatingly smiled, "If I want to find Nian Nian, I must survive. And the prerequisite for surviving is handling the immediate matter properly."

He raised his head toward the幽冥谷 direction, his eyes burning with unwavering fire.
"Ye Qing, wait for me. No matter what, I will rescue you—and then, extract the whereabouts of Nian Nian from you."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji suddenly stopped, glancing back toward the trial space, his voice cold:
"Old dog Ling Yuan, you think you're at the fifth level, but you're actually only at the first. You want to use Ye Qing to bait me? Hmph, let me show you what anti-baiting looks like."

text.content:
He quickly analyzed the situation: Ling Yuan concealed in the shadows watching, three Holy Sect elders openly pursuing Ye Qing, while Ye Qing herself carried key clues about Chen Nian. This seemingly dangerous situation was actually full of exploitable gaps.

"Three factions, each with their own schemes." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a bold plan gradually forming in his mind. He would make these three factions exhaust each other, while he himself reaped the benefits amid the chaos.

choice.prompt: "The three factions are intricately entangled. How do you prepare to break the situation? Exploit the contradiction between Ling Yuan and the Holy Sect to create conflict, or forge an entirely different path to breakthrough?"

choices.description: "Deliberately reveal Ling Yuan's identity before the Holy Sect elders, letting them know the Tianqing Sect old Sect Master is secretly manipulating things. The Holy Sect hates正道 people meddling the most—they will definitely shift their firepower to deal with Ling Yuan. While they tear each other apart, you calmly rescue."
choices.visible_cost: "May completely infuriate Ling Yuan, endless troubles ahead"
choices.visible_reward: "Without expending a single soldier, reap the fisherman's benefits, greatly improves strategic evaluation"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan bears grudges avenges all wrongs"

text.content:
Chen Ji took a recording Jade Slip from his chest, secretly carving evidence of Ling Yuan's secret collusion with the Holy Sect.
"Old thing, you want to make me a chess piece?" A cold smile curled his lips, "Then I'll make you the target of everyone's attacks just this once."

choices.memory_label: 记录凌渊与圣宗勾结的证据

choices.description: "Forget all schemes and stratagems—you rush the battlefield at maximum speed. Relying on the Tianji Record Fragment's concealment effect, the Holy Sect elders may not discover you immediately. As long as you can take Ye Qing away before Ling Yuan acts, all problems are solved."
choices.visible_cost: "Consumes large amounts of Heavenly Fate Value for concealment"
choices.visible_reward: "Fastest speed rescue, maximum preservation of secrets Ye Qing carries"
choices.risk_hint: "If discovered, fighting multiple enemies is extremely dangerous"

text.content:
Chen Ji spoke no more. His周身 spiritual energy suddenly收敛, his entire person like a ghost融入 darkness racing toward the幽冥谷 direction. He gambled on the Tianji Record Fragment's concealment effect, gambled on being able to complete the rescue before enemies could react.
"Nian Nian... wait for me, your brother is coming to save you."

However, just as Chen Ji was about to set out, the Tianji Record Fragment shook violently once more. A段模糊的文字 appeared before his eyes—a prophecy he had never seen before—"When the Heavenly Fate Lock Key appears, the Heaven's chess game shall collapse."

Mo Xiansheng's voice carried irrepressible excitement: "Master! This is the opening prophecy of the complete Tianji Record! Miss Chen Nian is not just an ordinary family member—she is the destiny's key chosen by Heaven itself!"

Chen Ji gripped his fists tightly, complex light flickering in his eyes.
Little sister, little sister, what kind of turmoil have you been swept into?
